subject: Urgent: modelpack-7 deploy caused latency spike & hallucination uptick — exec action needed
messages:
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vanguardpay.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Chae <tim.chae@vanguardpay.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Spike in p95 + hallucination after ModelPack-7 rollout

Hi Naomi,

We started seeing a marked increase in p95 latency and a small but noticeable uptick in hallucination/incorrect answers after your team rolled ModelPack-7 at ~03:00 UTC this morning. Our user-facing throughput has dropped ~18% and we have a ~2% increase in 5xx error responses correlated with longer decode times.

Attached is a set of dashboard screenshots (p95, error-rate) and a few example user transcripts where answers are clearly off. This is impacting our risk workflows — CFO and Ops have both flagged this. Can you confirm whether any quantization or kernel changes were included in this deploy?

We need a short sync (30 min) ASAP to understand rollback options and next steps. Tim is available from 11:00–13:00 PT.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Lim
VP, Operations
VanguardPay
[Attachment: vanguardpay_p95_graphs_20260915.png (image/png)]
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vanguardpay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 + hallucination after ModelPack-7 rollout

Hi Sara — thank you for flagging and for the artifacts. We're prioritizing this. Preliminary notes: modelpack-7 included a new quantization profile (qv2-f) and a set of kernel changes targeted at smaller sequence workloads. We are seeing evidence that for VanguardPay's long-sequence risk scanner the new qprofile increases decode latency and occasionally produces answer truncation/hallucination when combined with your custom prompt prefix lengths.

Immediate asks from our side:
- Rishi: can you confirm whether we have a fast rollback path to modelpack-6 and qprofile qv1-stable for this tenant only?
- Marissa: please prepare the external comms and timeline; CFO/ops want clarity on SLA exposure.
- Sara/Tim: please share any additional failing transcripts and an example request id so we can correlate traces.

We'll schedule a 30-minute sync at 11:30 PT and include Eng + CS + Exec on the call. I'm escalating to our on-call SRE and the Model Ops team now.

Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: modelpack7_release_notes_20260914.pdf]
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vanguardpay.com>, Tim Chae <tim.chae@vanguardpay.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 + hallucination after ModelPack-7 rollout

Naomi / team — I pulled traces for the request ids Sara sent and ran a quick A/B against modelpack-6. Summary:
- Root cause: a change in quantization packing (qv2-f) plus a micro-optimization in attention kernels caused increased memory pressure on long prefixes. That triggers additional CPU fallback paths on our hybrid runtime for a subset of requests, adding ~120–250ms to p95.
- Secondary effect: tokenization offsets for a trimmed-prompt path created off-by-one context truncation in ~0.8% of responses; combined with a slightly higher temperature default in the new release, that manifests as the hallucination examples you saw.

Immediate mitigation plan (recommended):
1) Tenant-scoped rollback: revert VanguardPay to modelpack-6 + qv1-stable within 15 minutes. This is a config flip; no model re-push required.
2) Patch: backport tokenization fix + tighten temperature default in a hotfix branch; deploy next maintenance window.
3) Post-mortem: full perf trace review + new per-tenant rollout guard for long-sequence clients.

I have a fast-rollback play (Playbook: https://docs.redwood/model-rollbacks#fast-rollback) ready — it requires SRE approval and a brief maintenance window to rebind routing. If we roll back VanguardPay, we can preserve the global modelpack-7 rollout while minimizing customer impact.

Attachments: sample traces and p95 graphs included.
[Attachment: tracekit_vanguardpay_sample.zip]

—Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Software Engineer, Inference Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@vanguardpay.com>, Tim Chae <tim.chae@vanguardpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Spike in p95 + hallucination after ModelPack-7 rollout

Sara / Tim — quick update from our 11:30 PT call and the engineering analysis:
- We will perform a tenant-scoped rollback to modelpack-6 + qv1-stable for VanguardPay at 16:15 PT. Expected cutover < 5 minutes; we'll monitor SLOs for 60 minutes post-rollback.
- We will not roll back globally at this time — the change appears safe for most customers but adversely interacts with your long-sequence prompt shapes.
- Follow-ups: Rishi's team will push the tokenization/temperature hotfix and coordinate a staged re-roll next week with a canary for long-sequence tenants.

Marissa will follow up with a short customer note and an executive summary for your CFO. Tim/Sara — please confirm the 16:15 PT window or call out any constraints.

Thanks for the quick partnership here. We take these regressions seriously and will deliver a full RCA by Friday.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
